chunks: As for what has been narrated from the reports that include that the Master of the Age will die and then live, or be killed and then live, similar to what he narrated:

key_terms.صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ: The Master of the Age, a title for the Twelfth Imam

ai.seo_question: What do Shia reports say about the death and resurrection of the Imam of the Age?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi highlights reports suggesting the Imam of the Age may experience death or martyrdom followed by a return to life, a concept central to resolving the theological tension between his prolonged occultation and eventual reappearance. This narrative aligns with the Shia understanding of the Imam's unique status, where his life is not bound by ordinary human mortality, thereby sustaining hope during the Great Occultation.
